references.reason: Expression indexes must match the query expression; algebraic equivalence does not suffice.
The planner balances WHERE search and ORDER BY index cost; partial prefixes can still require sorting.
Secondary indexes carry rowid as the tie-breaker; sorting/index search behavior.

method.readTiming: actual current queryUsagePage turn API; rows + count + prepare + SAVEPOINT snapshot. Each sample averages >=16ms batches (1000-call cap). AB/BA alternates. Warm SQLite and OS cache; no worker IPC or UI rendering.
method.fixture: same sql-rollup seed; 100 turns/session; explicit original ids preserved, unknown times and timestamp ties included; copies of identical checkpointed DB
method.minimalIndexProbe: three candidate index definitions are tested separately with EXPLAIN and dbstat before copying the fixture; only one chosen index exists in the timed candidate
method.writeTiming: actual replaceSessions transaction+commit, same 100-turn session, checkpoint excluded, rollups not materialized; warmup may reuse pages
method.storage: checkpointed dbstat object allocation plus page/freelist/file sizes before writes; WAL byte counts are file lengths, not physical I/O
caveats: provider-basis latest sort index only; model unknown-order expressions do not fully match
arbitrary header sorts, deep offsets, provider selectivity and cold caches may behave differently
index creation time is one observation, not a sampled A/B result
fixture probe drop leaves recyclable free pages equally in both copies; live bytes and index dbstat bytes distinguish allocation from physical file length
product source and installed/private DBs are unchanged
